subject: Buying orchestra: seatmap, decision criteria, and champion playbook
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@avasolutions.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + next asks (decision seatmap + procurement path)

Jordan — thanks for the demo time this morning. Quick recap for the team and next steps so we all stay aligned.

What we heard from Ava Solutions (high level):
- Primary decision criteria: 1) predictable latency under 200ms for critical queries, 2) 40–60% reduction in per-token inference cost versus current self-hosted endpoint, 3) ability to run in your VPC for PII workloads.
- Economic buyer: Jordan Hayes (VP Product) — cares about unit economics and GTM velocity.
- Security & procurement: Melissa Tran (procurement) and security@ava.com will own SOC2 evidence, data retention, and network isolation scoping.
- Champion: Jordan has agreed to be the internal sponsor and will help surface legal/procurement contacts.

Outstanding asks we promised during the call:
1) Preliminary ROI/TCO model scoped to Ava’s 10k daily chats (attachment: ROI_TCO_model.xlsx). Naomi — can you baseline the savings case with our 3 config scenarios (hosted, dedicated, private)? Target: 06/25.
2) Security call: share Redwood’s security one-pager and SOC2 snapshot (attachment: redwood-security-sheet.pdf). Jordan — can you share the security contact details so we loop them into a 30-min sync?
3) Procurement & SOW: attach draft SOW for review (Ava_SOW_draft_v1.pdf). Ben — flag any commercial language we should soften before legal sees it.
4) Exec brief for Jordan’s leadership: 1-pager with outcomes and recommended rollout (Ben + Priyom).

Next steps / dates:
- Naomi: ROI model v0 by 06/25
- Ben: Exec brief draft by 06/24 and SOW language suggested edits by 06/23
- Priyom: schedule security + procurement sync once Jordan confirms contacts (aim for week of 06/29)

Thanks — I’ll consolidate into a mutual action plan doc and share the link after Ben/Naomi confirm.

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: Ava_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, ROI_TCO_model.xlsx, redwood-security-sheet.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@avasolutions.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next asks (decision seatmap + procurement path)

On 21 Jun 2026, Priyom wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the demo time this morning. Quick recap for the team and next steps so we all stay aligned.

Nice write-up. A few quick additions from my side:
- For the exec brief, let’s lead with hard numbers (current spend per 1M tokens, Redwood expected spend per 1M tokens across 3 configs, and latency lift). Naomi — can you include the 3-year NPV and payback in the ROI model.
- Champion playbook: I’ll draft 4 short talking points Jordan can use with CTO/legal: 1) measurable cost savings, 2) single-vendor SLA for inference, 3) private deployment option for PII, 4) support & migration credits.
- For SOW: avoid commitment language around peak burst capacity (procurement usually flags that). Keep opt-in burst in an appendix.

I’ll start the exec brief skeleton and post to the drive. Priyom — if you get Melissa’s contact, I’ll prepare the SOW notes for legal to digest.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@avasolutions.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@ava.com>, procurement@ava.com
Date: 2026-06-21T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next asks (decision seatmap + procurement path)

Thanks Priyom and Ben — good summary. Quick responses:
- Security contact: security@ava.com (CC’d here) and our lead is Rajiv Kumar (rajiv.kumar@ava.com). Please send the SOC2 snapshot and a short runbook of what data stays in the VPC.
- Procurement: Melissa (CC’d) will be our reviewer for SOW and commercial terms. Melissa, can you confirm procurement’s standard review timeline? We typically do 2–3 week legal review for vendor SOWs.
- Timeline: Our target is a pilot in Q3 with a decision by mid-August. Jordan

—Jordan Hayes
VP Product, Ava Solutions

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@avasolutions.com>, Melissa Tran <melissa.tran@ava.com>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv.kumar@ava.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + next asks (decision seatmap + procurement path)

Looping back with an internal checklist and champion enablement plan (compact) — want to make it easy for Jordan to sell internally.

Mutual action plan (short):
- 06/23: Ben — Exec brief (1-pager) with 3 bullets for Jordan’s leadership (value, risk mitigation, ask). Attach: exec_brief_v1.pdf (will upload).
- 06/25: Naomi — ROI_TCO_model.xlsx v0 + 3-year NPV and payback scenarios.
- 06/29–07/01: Security + procurement 30-min sync (Priyom to coordinate with Jordan/Melissa/Rajiv).
- 07/15: Target pilot kickoff (internal confirmation).

Champion enablement package (deliverables):
1) One-page talking points for Jordan (what to say to CEO/CTO/Procurement) — include plain-language ROI callouts and 2 charts from the ROI model.
2) Risk mitigation FAQ for legal/security (SOC2, retention, encryption, private VPC pattern).
3) Trial SOW with optional burst appendix and migration credit language.

Naomi — for the template: focus the ROI slides on monthly run-rate impact and 12-month cumulative savings. Ben — I’ll need the two leadership bullets by EOD 06/23 so I can embed in the one-pager.

I’ll create a shared Drive folder (link to follow) and send Jordan a one-click package so he can forward to his execs.

Thanks everyone — Priyom

Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
